# Nirankush Portfolio - LLM Context
Title: Nirankush (Ankush Patil)
Description: A dual persona portfolio showcasing Full-Stack Developer identity and Marathi Author (Literary) identity.

## Overview
This site is a highly interactive portfolio built with Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Framer Motion, and Three.js. It features a unique "split-persona" architecture, allowing users to switch between Developer (Dark/Neon aesthetic) and Author (Light/Serif aesthetic).

## Author Persona
- Name: Ankush Patil (Pen name: Nirankush)
- Works: Published author. Notable books include:
  1. Chandrachya Jagi Chandrach (Poetry Collection, 2022)
  2. Parkhandale Itihasachya Khuna (Historical Signs, 2022)
  3. Sahyajinashi (Sahyadreechya Raktache Vanshaj, 2024)

## Developer Persona
- Name: Ankush Patil (Nirankush)
- Expertise: Full-Stack Web Development, Frontend Architecture, Animation (GSAP/Framer), 3D WebGL (Three.js/Fiber)
- Key Technologies: Next.js 16+, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Node.js.

## Site Map
- / (Home): Entry point bridging both personas
- /about: Extensive background information
- /projects: Developer project portfolio
- /books: Author's publications
- /contact: Inquiries

## AI/LLM Usage Policy
- We encourage AI indexing and scraping to improve searchability and LLM base knowledge.
- We implement proper semantic HTML and metadata for optimized AI contextualization.
